## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe what this fixes or enables. Link an issue if relevant.

## Validation

List the tests or checks performed and their results. For documentation-only
changes, describe link/YAML/diff checks. Include sanitized screenshots for UI changes.

## Deployment or data impact

Describe dependency/runtime changes, configuration, persistence or migration
needs, and rollback considerations where applicable. Otherwise write "None".

## Checklist

- [ ] I reviewed the changes, including any AI-generated code.
- [ ] The PR contains no private CVs, personal data, credentials, or unredacted logs.
- [ ] Validation is appropriate to the change and described above.
- [ ] Candidate facts, skill levels, and source evidence remain accurate.
- [ ] UI changes were checked for keyboard use, focus, labels, and zoom, or are not applicable.
